title: 1Presence — Your AI that knows you
excerpt: Your thinking partner, always here. Persistent memory, personal vault, dedicated AI.
content_html:
Personal AI · Memory you own · Connected

Presence remembers your conversations, keeps your notes, and thinks alongside you — across every session, every device.

A personal AI assistant with lasting memory — it manages your email and calendar, connects the apps you use, and keeps what it learns as plain files in your own vault. Yours to read, correct or export.

See how it works

Free to join. No credit card. Nothing leaves without your say-so.

Memory

It remembers. You focus.

Most AI resets the moment you close the tab. Presence builds a semantic memory across every conversation — projects, preferences, context, decisions. Ask about something from three weeks ago. It knows.

Read more about memory

3 weeks ago

Mentioned the Q3 strategy feels underfunded

2 weeks ago

Asked about competitive pricing models

Last Tuesday

Left off on section 3 — competitive positioning

Yesterday

Decided to push the pricing angle harder

Vault

Your documents live here now.

Not a notes feature — your master document store, above the drive folders and desktop copies. Every document opens right here with Presence beside it, so you edit, ask, and decide in one place. Everything you file feeds memory, so the vault gets smarter as it grows. And underneath, it's plain markdown in your own cloud — Obsidian-compatible, portable, yours.

Read more about your vault

Supplier agreement — terms

Payment falls due thirty days from invoice, with a two-percent early-settlement discount inside ten.

Either party may end the agreement with sixty days’ written notice — ninety in the first year.

Liability is capped at the fees paid in the preceding twelve months.

Is the notice period safe for us?

PresenceSixty days is fine — but given the onboarding cost you flagged in March, I’d hold ninety for year one. I’ve drafted the change.

Connected

Your tools, one conversation.

Presence reaches across the tools you already use — email, calendar, files, and fifteen-plus services, from Gmail and Google Calendar to Notion, GitHub, Slack and Microsoft 365 — reading context and acting with your approval. Ask it to brief you before the Meridian call, and it pulls the calendar event, the email threads, the project notes and the Notion page into one two-minute brief.

Read more about connectors

You, 13:47“Brief me before the Meridian call.”

CalendarToday, 14:00 — Meridian quarterly review, 45 min, their side brings three.

EmailTwo open threads: the revised pricing (they countered Tuesday) and the delayed onboarding.

VaultYour notes say hold firm on the platform fee; concede on payment terms if pressed.

NotionProject page shows two of three launch milestones done — lead with that.

Writing

It writes the things you need written.

A marketing strategy. A sales pitch. The reply you've been avoiding. A first draft of an agreement. Presence already knows your work, your people and your voice — so what it produces reads like you wrote it, not like a template. Every piece lands as a note in your vault, ready to edit, keep, or share as a link.

Read more about what it writes

Why Acme should move now

Your team is losing four hours a week to manual reconciliation. Last quarter’s numbers make the cost plain —

here is the plan to win those hours back, in three steps

Meetings

Every meeting, remembered.

Hand Presence a meeting link — Meet, Zoom or Teams — and it sits in. What it leaves in your vault is the record you wish every meeting had: the transcript, a clean summary, the decisions made, and the action items with names against them. Connect your calendar and it attends everything, automatically.

Read more about the meeting recorder

Decisions

Platform fee holds at the current rate

Payment terms move to net-45

Action items

Send the revised agreementYou · Fri

Confirm the onboarding dateDana · Mon

Routines

Your week, running itself.

The recurring parts of your week run on their own — a morning brief waiting with your coffee, a Friday wrap-up that writes itself, a Monday report produced and ready for your eye. You describe the outcome in plain words; Presence works out the steps and runs them on schedule.

Read more about routines

Ran to completionToday, 7:00

Ran to completionYesterday, 7:00

Ran to completionWednesday, 7:00

Brief — Friday 24 July.mdJust now

Your agent

Private by design.

Every account gets its own agent — spun up on demand, isolated to you, never shared with anyone. Your data lives in your own cloud bucket, and nothing leaves it without your confirmation. And when one Presence isn't enough, grow it into a team of specialists — shaped, like everything here, by conversation.

Read more about how it works

Runs in isolation — yours alone

Your data in your own cloud bucket

Acts only with your approval

Recalls every session

Grows into a team of specialists
